auth_details: No key is required for basic public question requests; subscribed features use an API key in the x-api-key header.
free_tier_limits: Free public access for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0); higher limits with a free/subscription API key.
paid_plans: Commercial/premium subscriptions available for commercial use and higher rate limits (see site pricing).
description: Public trivia questions API with categories, difficulty filters, tags, and region options. Basic question endpoints work without a key; subscriptions unlock higher limits and commercial use via x-api-key.
resolution_notes: Pending live verification of docs_url, auth, pricing, and description against official sources.
